t: Universal clamps designed for the safe transporting and securing of ladders onto vehicle roof bars and racks. Will fit most roof bars, rack profiles and types of 2 or 3-section ladders (max. ladder weight 40kg). Manufactured from tough composite plastic using a stainless steel hook and accredited by 20g crash and life cycle testing. One-touch clamping method ensures that the operation is up to 5 times quicker than traditional screw-down ladder clamps. Supplied as a pair, complete with 2 locking keys.
b: Accomodates up to 3 Nested Ladder Sections
